label: Aristotle, Physics III.1, 201a10-11: A being is being moved in a respect exactly when it is…
interpretation: Respect-indexed reading in the prima via's vocabulary of beings and respects: a being is being moved in a respect exactly when it is potentially so and that potency, precisely as a potency, is being actualized. The respect plays the part of the outcome in the -B reading; the qua-potential actualization stays primitive, so the reading adds no time, mover, completion or survival of the potency. It differs from -A and -B in speaking of a moved being rather than of an occurrence that is a change.
